authority: metric definition frozen before candidate outcomes; no strategy/threshold changes
scope: completed actual native prefix artifacts only; no launches, ledger/freeze/product edits, reconstruction or shadow PnL

expected_shortfall20.tail: Sort losses descending; let q=0.2*n. Sum floor(q) largest losses plus fractional remainder times next loss, divide by q. No rounding, clipping, or outcome-selected tail membership.
expected_shortfall20.numeric: Decimal from serialized actual values; UNKNOWN for unavailable/nonpositive required start equity

daily.calendar: 136 common UTC dates 2024-09-01 through 2025-01-14 inclusive; initial seed 10000
daily.endpoint: Actual coherent native TOTAL at last complete source-minute each UTC day using source_ns, never lagged receipt_ns; include flat days.
daily.terminal_exception: Last day may use validated direct terminal native cash only if last source watermark absent AND actual both legs flat/orders zero; otherwise UNKNOWN.

parent.population: All actual closed nonoverlapping BTC parent cycles per variant, with changed calendars reported; no shared-survivor selection or forced archived83 alignment.
parent.endpoints: Actual native TOTAL immediately before actual first BTC fill through actual both legs flat and associated orders quiescent after parent, including actual fees and funding.
parent.insufficient_proof: UNKNOWN; never rollback later marks or replay fills

gates.matched_OFF: same frozen source/liquidity policy; positive fully reconciled TOTAL
gates.accounting: cash/orders/signed funding/continuous settled plus coherent event coverage/terminal all PASS; no liquidation, stranded inventory, unauthorized increase, unprotected dust or overdue trim debt
gates.combined_capital: combined terminal TOTAL >= 2 * OFF terminal TOTAL
gates.incremental_gain: combined TOTAL - OFF TOTAL > 2 * combined actual SOL plus paired-BTC-trim fees
gates.settled_DD: candidate <= 50% and OFF - candidate >= 5 percentage points
gates.tails: Both DAILY and PARENT ES20 <= respective OFF ES20; conservative reading of frozen daily/nonoverlapping-parent requirement
gates.activations: at least 3 completed, at least one actual SOL TP fill and one non-TP risk/expiry path; natural missing sample INCONCLUSIVE
gates.selection: B2 attribution only; combined failure stops, no post-outcome B2 promotion
gates.advance: any missing required proof UNKNOWN blocks PASS; full budget remains zero

failed_runs: physical1 and physical2 diagnostic raw only; never passing controls
processing: One streaming analysis pass per completed variant after root/executor completion notice; partial streams never final.
